structure TauCeti.BrauerAlgebra (R : Type u_1) [CommSemiring R] (δ : R) (k : ℕ) :
Type u_1

The Brauer algebra B_k(δ) on k strands with loop value δ over R: the free R-module on the Brauer diagrams on k strands, with the multiplication that stacks two diagrams and weights the result by δ to the number of closed loops left in the middle (TauCeti.BrauerAlgebra.of_mul_of). An element is given by its coefficients in the diagram basis.

  • ofCoeff :: (
    • coeff : BrauerDiagram k →₀ R

      The coefficients of an element of the Brauer algebra in the diagram basis.
